brand_identity.tagline: Architecting Digital Precision & Growth for Global Enterprise SMEs
brand_identity.art_direction: Awwwards-grade Modern Dark Premium with Editorial Serif Elegance. Merges high-net-worth boutique financial consulting aesthetic with deep technical mastery. Obsidian charcoal canvas, warm champagne/gold metallic accents, crisp grid lines, and kinetic editorial motion.

headings.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif font-medium tracking-tight leading-[1.1]
headings.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif font-normal tracking-tight leading-snug
headings.h3: text-xl sm:text-2xl font-serif font-medium tracking-tight leading-snug

labels_and_mono.overline: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.25em] font-mono text-amber-300/80 font-medium
labels_and_mono.stat_number: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-mono font-semibold tracking-tight text-amber-200

colors.theme_mode: Dark Premium Base with Editorial Warm Accents
colors.contrast_rules: All text must achieve >= 4.5:1 APCA/WCAG contrast against background. Never place plain text over raw image without gradient/backdrop scrim. Never use completely transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or floating headers.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Swiss Editorial Bento Grid with asymmetrical tension (12 columns on desktop: col-span-12, md:col-span-8, lg:col-span-4)
spacing_and_layout.header_rules: Header fixed z-50 with backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A0E17]/85 border-b border-[#1F2D47]. Body padding top pt-24.

kinetic_hero.description: Large kinetic hero featuring line-by-line masked headline reveal (using Framer Motion initial y:100% overflow-hidden span), live metric tickers, interactive subtle particle background, and dual CTA.
kinetic_hero.headline: Empowering SMEs Worldwide with Sovereign IT & Digital Strategy.

services_showcase.description: Bento-style 4-card detailed grid with interactive tab expansion, deep feature lists, technology stack chips, and downloadable/requestable capability brief modal.

manifesto_chapters.description: Numbered editorial approach chapters (01. Precision Diagnostics, 02. Frictionless Integration, 03. Data-Driven Sovereignty, 04. Scalable Global Impact) with accordion & sticky side preview.

editorial_marquee.description: Slow, elegant kinetic ribbon running continuous key brand values (IT CONSULTANCY • SOFTWARE INTEGRATION • DATA ANALYTICS • PROCESS OPTIMIZATION) in giant outlined serif typography.

about_firm_story.description: Editorial firm biography highlighting London headquarters, international SME reach, advisory board, and key trust metrics.

contact_enquiry_form.description: Interactive multi-step consultancy enquiry form (saves enquiries to backend database with email confirmation simulation, budget select, service checkboxes, validation, and toast notification).

specifications.scroll_reveal: framer-motion viewport={{ once: true, margin: '-100px' }} initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 30 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.7, ease: [0.215, 0.61, 0.355, 1] }}
specifications.hover_effects: Cards lift -translate-y-2 with shadow-2xl transition-all duration-300 border-[#E2C08D]/40

pages_blueprint.title: About Us | Nivi Finserv Ltd.
sections: About Hero Banner with London Office Focus

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete multi-page React application (.js / .jsx files) using React Router.
Ensure Lenis smooth scrolling is enabled globally across all route changes.
Implement top navigation bar with clear active page state, gold accent underline, and instant navigation without full page reload.
Implement backend FastAPI contact enquiry endpoint in backend/server.py if required, or mock robust client-side storage with toast notification.
Ensure all interactive buttons, forms, links, and cards contain `data-testid` attributes as specified in required_test_ids.
Follow strictly the dark premium + editorial serif color scheme (#0A0E17 obsidian background, #E2C08D champagne gold accents, Playfair Display headers).
